user_query: What are the walk-in hours for Counseling Services this term, and is a referral required?

retrieved_docs.text: Counseling Services — Walk-in hours are Monday–Thursday 13:00–15:30. No referral is required for the first visit. After-hours crisis line: 555-0199 (campus extension). Assistants should quote the public hours only.
